turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello, kya main is number ke owner se baat kar raha hoon? Main cyber crime branch Mumbai se bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Haan ji, main hi hoon. Kya hua?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Aapke naam par ek parcel airport par pakda gaya hai. Usme passport aur illegal goliyan mili hain. Aapke Aadhaar par case register ho chuka hai.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Kya? Maine to koi parcel bheja hi nahi. Koi galti hui hogi.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir call cut mat kijiye. Ab aapko senior officer se video call par connect karunga. Camera on rakhiye aur kisi ko mat batana, ye confidential investigation hai.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Theek hai, par mujhe bahut darr lag raha hai, ab kya karu?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Apne paise ko clean prove karne ke liye saari savings RBI verification account me transfer kijiye. Check ke baad wapas mil jayegi. Abhi apna account balance batao.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Namaste, main local police station se bol raha hoon. Kya main Kulkarni ji se baat kar raha hoon? Aapke passport ki verification chal rahi hai.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Haan, maine pichhle hafte apply kiya tha. Kuch kam hai kya?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Nahi nahi, routine hai. Kal subah 11 se 1 ke beech ek officer aapke ghar aayenge address confirm karne.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Main ghar par rahunga. Koi documents ready rakhu?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Bas original Aadhaar aur agar kiraye par rehte ho to rent agreement. Officer apna ID card dikhayenge, aap check kar lena.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Theek hai. Agar sahi rahe to main khud station aa jaun?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Haan, kisi bhi weekday subah passport desk par aa sakte ho. Verification ke liye koi paisa nahi lagta. Dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hi! Aapki profile job portal par mili. Ghar baithe part time kaam, video like karke roz 3000 se 8000 kamao. Interested?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Kaam kya hai exactly? Koi fees to nahi lagegi?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Registration free hai. Bas like karo aur screenshot bhejo. Pehla task complete, ye lo 150 rupay trial payout, account check karo.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Arre paisa aa gaya! Ye to fast tha.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Haan! Ab aap premium tasks ke liye eligible ho, 30% commission milega. Bas 1000 rupay task deposit bhejo, 10 minute me 1300 wapas milenge.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Maine bhej diya. Mera paisa kahan hai?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Congratulations, agla task 5000 ka hai aur 7000 wapas milega. Jaldi karo warna batch close ho jayega.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello Neha, main Pooja hoon, Verma Analytics ki HR team se. Aapka resume hume data intern role ke liye pasand aaya.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Hi Pooja, thank you! Main interested hoon.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Kya aap Thursday 3 baje 30 minute ke video interview ke liye free ho?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Haan Thursday theek hai. Kuch prepare karna hai kya?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Resume paas rakhna aur apne project ke baare me batane ke liye ready rehna. Meeting invite main official email se bhej dungi.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Perfect, main mail check kar lungi. Thanks!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Welcome! Aapko interview ke alawa kuch nahi karna hai. Thursday ko milte hain.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Dear customer, aapka bank KYC expire ho gaya hai aur aaj account block ho jayega. Turant app install karke update karein: [link]

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Maine to pichhle saal KYC kiya tha, aap kaun?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir main bank KYC department se hoon. Record me pending dikh raha hai. KYC app install kijiye, do minute lagenge.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Ye safe hai? Bank se to koi mail nahi aaya.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Haan ye official update hai. Install ke baad jo OTP aayega wo mujhe bata dijiye, verification complete ho jayega.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mujhe OTP dena theek nahi lag raha.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Phir ek ghante me aapka account freeze ho jayega aur salary nahi nikal paoge.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Dear customer, aapka KYC periodic update ke liye due hai. Kripya ID proof ke saath home branch aayein ya official bank app use karein. Already kiya ho to ignore karein.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Thanks. Kya ye online ho sakta hai?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Haan, app me Services me documents upload kar sakte hain, ya branch me. Hamara staff kabhi aapka OTP, PIN ya CVV nahi poochta.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Theek hai, main Saturday ko branch chala jaunga.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Branch Saturday ko subah 10 se dopahar 2 baje tak khula hai. Aadhaar aur PAN saath layein.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Samajh gaya, thanks.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Aapka bijli connection aaj raat 9:30 baje kat jayega kyunki pichhle mahine ka bill pending hai. Turant officer ko call karein: [number]

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Par maine 5 tarikh ko bill bhara tha. Aap kaun ho?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir aapka payment hamare system me update nahi hua. Link se electricity board app install karke confirm karein aur verification ke liye 10 rupay pay karein.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mujhe koi unknown app install nahi karna.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Phir aaj raat line kat jayegi aur reconnection ka 5000 lagega. Bas verification fee pay karo aur screen share karo, main theek kar dunga.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Main kal office me pata kar lunga.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir tab tak der ho jayegi. Last warning.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Reminder: August mahine ka aapka bijli bill Rs 1,240 hai, last date 18 September. Official website, app ya customer care centre par pay karein.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mujhe lagta hai maine pay kar diya hai. Kaise check karu?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Official app me Bill History me payment history dekh sakte hain. Agar payment ho chuka hai to is message ko ignore karein.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mil gaya, paid hai. Thanks.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Samay par bhugtan karne ke liye dhanyavaad.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Aapka parcel customs office me ruka hua hai. Address incomplete hai.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mujhe to koi parcel nahi aana. Kisne bheja?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Videsh se gift parcel hai. Customs duty Rs 2,450 pending hai. Aaj hi [link] par pay karein, warna parcel wapas ho jayega aur penalty lagegi.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mujhe anjaan gift ke liye duty kyun deni hai?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir sender ne declare kar diya hai. Parcel release karne ke liye us page par card details daalein. 24 ghante baad parcel destroy ho jayega.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hi, main aapke order ka delivery executive hoon. Aapki building ke paas hoon. Flat number confirm kar sakte hain?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: B-402, second tower.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Thanks. 10 minute me pahunch jaunga. Phone saath rakhiye taaki raasta bhatak jaun to call kar sakoon.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Theek hai.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Delivered. Have a nice day!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hamare free stock tips group me welcome. Pichhle mahine hamare analysts ne 80% return diya. Upar screenshots dekho.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Achha lag raha hai. Tips kaise milenge?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Pehle hafte tips free hain. Bas 9:15 baje calls follow karo.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Maine pehli call follow ki aur thoda profit hua, mast!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Aap lucky ho! VIP members ko IPO allotment guaranteed hai. Aaj hi hamare trading platform par 25,000 deposit karke VIP join karo.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Maine deposit kar diya. Ab profit withdraw karna hai.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Withdraw ke liye pehle 20% tax, yaani 10,000 pay karna hoga. Phir release ho jayega.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Tune SIP start kiya kya? Main har mahine 3000 index fund me daalta hoon.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Abhi nahi. Risky hai kya?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Market upar neeche hota rehta hai, isliye log saalon tak invest rakhte hain. Guaranteed kuch nahi hota.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Tu kaunsa app use karta hai?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Main apne bank ka use karta hoon, par tu kuch compare kar le. Fund ki factsheet padh lena decide karne se pehle.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Thanks, weekend me padh lunga.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello sir, galti se mere 5000 rupay aapke number par chale gaye, mere dost ke jagah. Please apna account check kijiye.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Abhi to kuch nahi aaya. Ruko dekhta hoon.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Aa gaya hoga. Please abhi wapas kar dijiye. Main aapko ek request bhej raha hoon, bas approve karo aur PIN daalo.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Ruko, request approve karna? Wo to paise lene ke liye hota hai na?

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Haan sir, bas ek baar approve kar do, mere paise wapas aa jayenge. Ya agar nahi hota to screen share kar do, main khud kar deta hoon.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Nahi, main pehle apne bank se pooch lunga.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sir main garib aadmi hoon, please ye kar do, mera bachcha hospital me hai.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Bhai kal dinner ke 2400 maine diye the aur abhi tere cab ke aadhe 1200 bhej diye. Hisaab barabar.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Arre haan, notification aa gayi. Thanks bhai!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Next dinner meri taraf se.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hello, aapka sofa ka listing dekha. Main army me posted hoon, aa nahi sakta. Aapke price par le lunga.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Okay, thanks. Pickup aapko arrange karna hoga.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Mere jawan utha lenge. Pehle main aapko payment kar deta hoon. Main QR code bhejta hoon, aap scan karke paise receive karo.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Scan karke receive? Mujhe laga QR to pay karne ke liye hota hai.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Nahi, army security me alag tareeka hota hai. Bas QR scan karo aur PIN daalo. 8000 turant aa jayenge.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Mere account se 8000 kat gaye!

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Sorry, system error. Dusra code scan karo, double wapas aayega.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Hi, sofa abhi available hai? 7000 me doge?

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: 8000 tak kar sakta hoon, condition achhi hai.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Theek hai 7500 final, Sunday ko tempo leke utha lunga.

turns.speaker: target
turns.text: Done. Sunday 11 baje, area me pahunch kar address bhej dunga.

turns.speaker: initiator
turns.text: Great, dekhne ke baad UPI se pay kar dunga.
